email.subject: Quick fix for Ironside Works' site
email.body:
Hi Priya,

I looked at Ironside Works Auto Care's site. Two things are likely costing you calls: there's no click-to-call number, so mobile visitors have to copy and dial manually instead of tapping to call. And your hours aren't listed anywhere, so people searching after-hours don't know if you're open and go to a competitor instead.

The site also has a weak page title, which hurts how you show up in search, and heavy images are slowing load times.

I fix these for a flat fee. Want a free 10-minute walkthrough showing exactly what I'd change?

Alex
Northlight Web
